stanza: Everybody I talk to is ready to leave
With the light of the morning
They've seen the end coming down long enough to believe
That they've heard their last warning
Each has his own ticket in his hand

q.line: Have all eventually come down to waiting for Everyman
stanza: Seems like I've always been looking for some other place
Where with a few of my friends I could give up the race
Well thought out schemes to gain the motherland
Have all eventually come down to waiting for Everyman
